categories.main_business_segments: BYBON Group primarily operates in the mobile phone after-sales service industry, focusing on two main segments: mobile phone repair services and alliance business. The repair services include authorized in-warranty and out-of-warranty repairs, mainly for Apple products. The alliance business integrates numerous small repair shops under the 'Shandianfeng' brand, providing them with genuine Apple parts, peripheral products, technical support, and second-hand phone trade services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes digital transformation and automation, achieving over 90% business process automation and integrating AI-driven decision-making in key operations. It has developed a comprehensive digital system including front-end, business middle platform, data middle platform, and cloud infrastructure. The alliance SaaS system, supply chain management system, and order dispatching via algorithmic matching are key technological tools supporting operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: BYBON serves individual consumers needing mobile phone repairs, especially Apple users, and a vast network of small and medium-sized repair shops across China. Its alliance business targets independent repair technicians, shop owners, and repair chains, providing them with genuine parts and services. The company also engages in second-hand phone sales and peripheral product sales, catering to both end-users and repair service providers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across mainland China, covering over 200 cities including first, second, and strong third-tier cities. It has 57 self-operated stores and over 15,000 alliance stores nationwide. Its supply chain and logistics infrastructure support rapid delivery services, including 30-minute delivery in many locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: BYBON operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the mobile phone repair supply chain. It procures genuine parts directly from manufacturers (notably Apple) and supplies these to its own stores and alliance partners. The company also manages logistics and inventory through front warehouses to ensure timely delivery to repair shops.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on expanding its alliance network, enhancing supply chain efficiency, and deepening digital and AI capabilities. R&D efforts concentrate on developing digital platforms for order management, inventory control, and customer engagement. BYBON aims to improve service quality, operational efficiency, and user experience through continuous technological innovation and data-driven decision-making.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service fees from authorized mobile phone repairs (both in-warranty and out-of-warranty), sales of genuine repair parts and peripheral products to alliance partners, and second-hand phone sales. The company also earns from value-added services such as mobile phone protection plans and management consulting fees from alliance partners. Online platforms like Douyin are leveraged for customer acquisition and order generation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: BYBON is the only publicly listed mobile phone service provider in China, positioning itself as a market leader with significant scale advantages in store network, supply chain, and digital capabilities. It competes against a highly fragmented market dominated by numerous small, independent repair shops. Its 'Shandianfeng' brand aims to consolidate this fragmented market by providing standardized, high-quality services and genuine parts, differentiating from competitors offering lower-quality or counterfeit components.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, BYBON reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 475.65 million, a 30.21% decline from the previous year, primarily due to strategic shifts towards smaller customers and increased investment in logistics infrastructure. The net loss attributable to shareholders narrowed by 45.83% to RMB 15.48 million. The company’s alliance store count surged by over 9,500 to more than 15,000, indicating strong network growth despite short-term revenue pressure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: BYBON emphasizes high-quality, genuine Apple parts and standardized repair services to build consumer trust in a fragmented market. Its unique value lies in integrating a vast network of small repair shops under a unified brand with digital tools, supply chain support, and marketing capabilities. The company’s digital and AI-driven operational systems enhance efficiency and customer experience, differentiating it from traditional repair providers and counterfeit parts sellers.
